name: voice-of-customer
description: Guided build for a voice-of-customer pipeline on reviews, social posts and survey open-ends already in Snowflake. Normalizes and deduplicates feedback, resolves language and links SKUs, classifies every item against a governed, versioned two-level taxonomy with AI_CLASSIFY, scores aspect-level sentiment with AI_SENTIMENT, detects emerging themes over time including themes the taxonomy does not yet contain, writes theme summaries by product, SKU, region and period with AI_SUMMARIZE_AGG and AI_AGG, and operationalizes the result as an incremental pipeline, semantic view and Cortex Agent. Ships a synthetic sandbox with a labeled answer key and planted emerging themes, measures topic and aspect-sentiment precision and recall and taxonomy drift handling, and produces a value readout for revenue (product, pricing, retention) and OpEx (returns, support) levers using customer-supplied inputs only.
